fullEndpointData.note: Unchanged training-stage artifact; its historical pending-comparison status is superseded by this completed report.

orderingDiagnostic.scope: Completed orbital training only; 48 paired candidate slots, observed in both arms (96 candidates, 576 flights). Counts below are per arm unless stated otherwise.

parameterBounds.explanation: The retained mutation adds scaled Gaussian covariance steps directly to 13 active coefficients; decode checks finite values and length but does not clip coefficients. There are no coefficient bounds at which to count collisions. Sigma floors, covariance diagonal regularization, and Cholesky numerical floors are distribution safeguards, not parameter bounds.

evaluation.interpretation: All twelve trips failed. Positive conditional-periapsis progress did not satisfy insertion.

definitions.eligibility: Finite periapsis and the strict apoapsis and radial-speed conditions
definitions.noEligibleSample: conditionalPeriapsis:null and P=0; never omit the failed case
definitions.nonfiniteEncoding: Nonfinite diagnostics remain explicit strings such as Infinity; null retains its distinct no-event/no-eligible meaning
definitions.durations: Original post-action physical intervals at the original 50/250 ms steps; reported pattern bits are periapsis, apoapsis, radial speed

provenance.trainingLimitation: Launch receipts retain exact explicit experiment settings, cwd, command, and source identities. The launcher retained non-SUITE ambient variables and resolved node through PATH; the full inherited environment and historical executable hash were not recorded.

limits: This is one paired optimizer seed and six development cases per arm, not a reliability estimate or proof of optimizer superiority.
There were no stable orbits, complete orbits or landings in 588 prescribed flights; no insertion capability or release eligibility was demonstrated.
Training lacked full trajectories. Its audit establishes retained outcome, proposal, optimizer and ranking arithmetic; the separate evaluation replay verifies every recorded physical step.
The two final controllers are identical to the frozen initial controller, so the matching evaluation outcomes do not compare two different learned policies.
An eligible P peak is a brief best-so-far statistic. It does not certify a three-second strict insertion hold or penalize later departure.
Ordering pair counts are exhaustive logical comparisons, not observed JavaScript sort-call counts.
Ground retention and independent JavaScript release tests were not performed in this experiment.

csv.encoding: arm/mode/reason are text; every other cell is exact JSON. All nested case summaries, eight predicate durations and physical deficits are retained.
